# kopia_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists the snapshots in the Kopia server's repository of one host, optionally narrowed to one user and one path, oldest first. It needs a repository connected.

Unless `all` is set, Kopia reports snapshots with identical contents once: each group of snapshots sharing a `root_id` appears as its oldest member, with the retention reasons and pins of the whole group. With `all`, every snapshot is listed, but the oldest of each such group still carries the reasons and pins of its group, because Kopia works them out on the same list.

~> **Set `user_name` and `path` when `retention` matters.** Kopia works out the retention reasons from the retention policy of the source asked for, applied to every snapshot listed, so a list that spans several sources gets reasons that mean nothing for any of them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The snapshots of one source. Give user_name and path whenever the retention
# reasons matter: Kopia works them out from the retention policy of the source
# asked for. With all = true, a snapshot whose contents match an older one is
# listed too, rather than hidden behind it.
data "kopia_snapshots" "app" {
  host      = "host1"
  user_name = "docker"
  path      = "/data/app"
  all       = true
}

locals {
  # Oldest first, so the last one is the newest.
  app_complete_snapshots = [for s in data.kopia_snapshots.app.snapshots : s if s.incomplete_reason == null]
  app_latest_snapshot    = try(local.app_complete_snapshots[length(local.app_complete_snapshots) - 1], null)
}

output "app_latest_snapshot_time" {
  value = try(local.app_latest_snapshot.start_time, null)
}

# Warn when the nightly backup has not completed for more than a day.
check "app_backed_up_recently" {
  assert {
    condition     = try(timecmp(local.app_latest_snapshot.start_time, timeadd(plantimestamp(), "-26h")) > 0, false)
    error_message = "No complete snapshot of docker@host1:/data/app in the last 26 hours."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host whose snapshots are listed. Kopia files every snapshot under its host and has no way to list the snapshots of every host at once.

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) List every snapshot, rather than one for each set of identical contents. Defaults to `false`.
- `path` (String) List only the snapshots of this path, compared as a plain string. Leave it out for every path.
- `user_name` (String) List only the snapshots of this user. Leave it out for every user of the host.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) The snapshots, sorted by `start_time`, oldest first; snapshots that started at the same moment come in no particular order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))
- `unfiltered_count` (Number) Number of snapshots found, before snapshots with identical contents were merged; unreadable snapshots are not counted.
- `unique_count` (Number) Number of distinct contents among the snapshots found: the length of `snapshots` unless `all` is set.

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot; empty when it has none.
- `end_time` (String) When the snapshot ended, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the snapshot's manifest. It changes whenever the snapshot is edited, so identify a snapshot by `start_time` across runs.
- `incomplete_reason` (String) Why the snapshot is incomplete — `checkpoint`, `canceled` or `limit reached` — or null for a complete snapshot.
- `pins` (List of String) Pins that keep the snapshot from being deleted by retention.
- `retention` (List of String) Why the retention policy keeps the snapshot, such as `latest-1` or `daily-2`, or `incomplete` for a recent incomplete one; empty when it does not keep it. Runs are merged, as in `daily-1..3`, for snapshots that stand for a group.
- `root_id` (String) Identifier of the snapshot's root object, which two snapshots of unchanged data share; null when the snapshot has no root.
- `start_time` (String) When the snapshot started, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC.
- `summary` (Attributes) Totals over the snapshot's root directory; null for a snapshot without one. Sizes are in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots--summary))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots--summary"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots.summary`

Read-Only:

- `dirs` (Number) Number of directories.
- `errors` (Attributes List) The first ten entries that could not be read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots--summary--errors))
- `files` (Number) Number of files.
- `incomplete_reason` (String) Why the tree is incomplete, or null when it is complete.
- `max_time` (String) Newest modification time in the tree, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC; the Unix epoch, `1970-01-01T00:00:00Z`, when there is none.
- `num_failed` (Number) Number of entries that could not be read.
- `num_ignored_errors` (Number) Number of errors the error-handling policy ignored.
- `size` (Number) Total size of the files.
- `symlinks` (Number) Number of symbolic links.

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots--summary--errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots.summary.errors`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) What went wrong.
- `path` (String) Path of the entry, within the snapshot.
